product.description: Monoprice™Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket Extra Long Extension Range to 12.6" for 13" to 37" TVs up to 44lbs, Max VESA 100x100The Monoprice Compact Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket is purpose-built to accommodate smaller TVs and monitors spanning 13 to 37 inches. With a weight capacity of 44 pounds, it's an excellent choice for small displays. Unlike traditional fixed or tilt mounts that cater to a single viewing angle, this full-motion mount is ideal for bedrooms or other smaller areas with multiple viewing zones.Crafted to fit snugly on a single stud, our compact mount optimizes space utilization while supporting up to 44 pounds. Its compact footprint is ideal for computer monitors and small televisions up to 37 inches in size. When flush against the wall, the mount positions itself just 1.7 inches away, ensuring an unobtrusive appearance. With a full-motion extension capability spanning up to 12.6 inches, you can effortlessly adjust the TV angle to suit different viewing areas—whether directing toward a bed, desk or minimizing glare from nearby windows.Beyond its full articulation capabilities, the Monoprice Compact Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket offers an impressive 180-degree swivel range. You can also tilt the screen upward or downward for optimal viewing comfort, and the level rotation ensures your display remains perfectly horizontal. Whether you're relaxing on the bed, sitting on the floor, or working at a desk, this wall mount provides the flexibility you need.To ensure compatibility with a wide range of televisions and computer monitors, the Monoprice Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket supports VESA mounting patterns from 75 x 75 up to 100 x 100. This broad range covers the majority of modern displays for television and computer use. Plus, it comes with all the necessary mounting hardware, so you won’t need to make any unnecessary trips to the local hardware store.In summary, the Monoprice Compact Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket provides impressive flexibility for small TVs and monitors ranging from 13 to 37 inches.
